== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Local Uprising / Liberation (V) (Errata)]], showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published card image shows this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-L-localuprising-pre.gif]]) and the Virtual Block 2 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB2-164E-Local_Uprising.png]]) show the original text. The 7 side (Liberation) did not change.

* '''Text source:''' the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013), Light Side. Icons are drawn as on the printed slips.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy Hoth system and [Virtual Block 6] Main Power Generators. May deploy Echo Base Garrison and/or Maneuvering Flaps. For remainder of game, you may not deploy Hoth Sentry or non-Hoth locations (except Rendezvous Point). T-47 Battle Formation may only be played once per game and is [Immune to Sense]. While this side up, during your deploy phase, may ▼ an exterior Hoth site or a non-unique Rebel to Hoth. Flip this card during your move phase if you control three exterior Hoth sites with T-47s and/or non-unique Rebels. Place out of play if Main Power Generators ‘blown away.’”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card (GEMP <code>1220_163</code>; printed frame, Decipher art, title, lore, icons and set mark as on the Players Committee card image) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
